name: Hands Springsprocket
summary: At Coldridge Pass, Hands Springsprocket struggles to keep supplies moving between the valley and Kharanos. Rockjaw troggs have blocked the route.

sections.title: A Bottleneck in the Pass
sections.body: At the mouth of Coldridge Pass, Hands Springsprocket finds his supply runs stopped by Rockjaw troggs. He usually carries provisions to the Thunderbrew distillery and the inn in Kharanos. The troggs have overrun the underground tunnel out of Coldridge Valley, halting trade and foot traffic. Now Hands depends on travelers who can carry essential crates through the dangerous mountain passage.

faq.answer: Hands Springsprocket is a gnome stationed in Coldridge Valley, just outside Coldridge Pass. He carries supplies to the lower reaches of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does he need help moving supplies?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have infested the pass between Coldridge Valley and the rest of Dun Morogh. Routine transport is too dangerous without armed escorts or capable travelers.
Hands arranges shipments to Kharanos, including goods for Tannok Frosthammer and the local innkeepers who depend on provisions from across the snowy peaks.

angles.text: Hands shows the determination of gnomes building trade ties in Dun Morogh alongside their dwarven allies.
Hands keeps supplies moving between the dwarven recruits in Coldridge Valley and settlements deeper in Dun Morogh.
